frequency_question: How often does the council successfully formally approve proposed rate clarifications or removal of exemptions on financial/intermediary services when brought to a vote within the specified timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes all formally tabled agenda items concerning financial service tax exemptions or rate reclassifications at council meetings over the past 8 years; excludes administrative or non-tax procedural matters.

cases.name: Exemption review for healthcare and educational services
Insurance premium GST rate reduction deliberation

coverage_note: 7 major service-tax adjustment proposals explicitly tracked and contested; represents the known population of contested service-classification agenda items.
known_gaps: Some minor state-level submissions or deferred subcommittee items that never reached formal voting agendas are excluded.
skeleton: Total tabled specific rate adjustments or removal of exemptions on services divided by total proposals formally reviewed by the council.
multiplier: 4 hits / 3 misses = 4/7 base rate for fiscal tightening/clarification approvals on services.
validity_reason: The voting dynamics and consensus-seeking structure of the fiscal council evolve slowly over legislative cycles.
